prose:
An accessible Bloomberg opening reports prosecutors' argument that former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan likely intercepted trade secrets and possessed a photograph apparently showing a strategic-partnership term sheet. It places those assertions in a filing opposing his latest bail request, while saying the investigation continues.

Only the opening was accessible, not the full article, filing or defense response. The wider feed description of numerous recordings is attributed reporting, not material independently reviewed here. Prosecutors' concerns and an ongoing investigation are not findings of guilt or proof of completed disclosure to any third party. No purported confidential recording or document was retrieved.
highlights: Accessible text concerns a bail-related prosecution filing
Trade-secret interception is alleged rather than adjudicated
Only the article opening was accessible
No confidential source material or defense response was inspected
